exposure: duration of active first stage of labor
outcome: duration of second stage of labor
cohort: 13,379 primiparous women with spontaneous labor onset in Stockholm-Gotland Region, Sweden, between 2008 and 2014
finding: Longer active first stage of labor duration was linearly associated with longer second stage of labor duration and higher odds of operative vaginal delivery and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Longer active first stage of labor duration was associated with increased occurrence of operative vaginal delivery and caesarean delivery.
